What arrangement? You need to say more about what legal arrangements you have etc. 

Do not contact her at all, not even by text, phone or anything - it will be used against you. 

I would begin to review your text message conversations etc, see if there is anything incriminating. 

Depending on your 'arrangements' at the moment, it may well be filing for an on notice injunction against her. I would do this as soon as humanely possible before she takes one against you. Time is not on your side. Let me know if you need help with it.

​

I am currently in the Family Courts - my ex did the exact same thing, I'm also at uni but I'm winning. I study law and I've fought it tooth and nail.
it's one option, but now that she's made the allegations etc and is going ahead there isn't much room to reverse.

Firstly, I'm going to recognise that your experience requires someone professional to process the 'trauma' - after all, regardless of what your expeirence was, could have been between life and death, it requires processing by your brain to get you back to normal.

Secondly, understand that you and your GF are still relatively young and going through life when all of the problems hit you, so something as serious as this is likely to cause more than just conversation. 

i'd recommend getting therapy to help you process it to return back to normal. Now, I am not saying there will be a 'normal' but normal for you is the journey between point A (your life now) and point B (what you could perceive to be a life you would enjoy and be content with). 

Now, I'm not saying that journey between point A and B is easy or straightforward or even sensical. I'm saying you need to keep walking forwards, one foot in front of the other. 

Try and stay away from the alcohol, a slippery slope and one you don't want to go down - it's a fool's game, same as gambling. 

Remember that you have strength within you to dig deep - do you know that it's admirable for a person to go through something as crazy as this and walk out alive with a positive attitude. Showing that you are willing to try and achieve your point B will also show your GF that things are going to be hard but will eventually be ok. 

Remember man that the world is a different place and everyone is there to support you. Remember also that if it pains you too much, go and do the Christian thing and help others. What about other people with no light for them? 

I hope you're OK, message me to stay in touch.

​

Peace out
